scope: Independent read-only static source and retained-result review. No candidate imports, execution, tests, proofs, model calls, source edits or builder contact. Only this review is written under /private/tmp.
authorization_hold: No fresh Markov research, curation, canary or activation before explicit user OK.

findings.title: Committed episode does not reserve its evaluation and review
findings.finding: The first episode reservation covers only research calls, up to k validations and one completion validation per round. Required episode evaluation and two review/selector calls are funded only after the promised research horizon finishes. A cap sufficient for research alone starts the episode, then blocks evaluation/review. Call/meta-call checks likewise cover only research at the horizon start. Symmetric policy-trial branch pools are repaired; this remaining defect concerns the main episode-to-review edge.
findings.required: Before accepting a delayed episode, admit the complete required horizon through its review/evaluation (including call counters), or explicitly expose a different horizon contract. This is a comparison/accounting requirement, not a mathematical strategy.

findings.title: Shipped fixture and canary protocols cannot start under the new envelope
findings.finding: Both inherit k=6 and validation_seconds=120. The fixture first episode requires 2*(2*5+7*120)=1700 reserved seconds against arm_seconds=1200. The canary requires 2*(2*120+7*120)=2160 against 1800. validate_protocol accepts both; research_round fails before its first role call. DEFAULT arm_seconds was corrected to 12000, so the earlier default-dictionary failure is superseded. The named profiles remain broken.
findings.required: Make shipped neutral profile(s) viable and statically reject impossible commitments at freeze. The live canary remains explicitly unauthorized; no execution or activation is proposed.

findings.title: Terminal completion export is not included or bound in the audit result
findings.finding: The producer now creates/reconciles terminal snapshots and outbox, fixing the missing producer. The report only checks terminal export conflicts; raw measurement and conditional pairs still iterate the initial+rounds schedule, excluding terminal. The terminal observer record also omits the checked resolution/result-bundle identity. Thus a separate exact-root completion between scheduled rounds is absent from the measured audit sequence and is not tied to its finished completion receipt there.
findings.required: Represent a terminal point in the consumer schedule, preserve absent-terminal semantics, and bind the terminal export to its exact finished resolution receipt/bundle. No complexity-based control feedback should be introduced.

findings.title: New enforced knowledge limit is not disclosed in role request limits
findings.finding: ingest rejects the entire report before checking anything when the aggregate across proposal kinds exceeds knowledge_checks_per_round. The request limits projection lists only rounds, episode_rounds, invention_rounds and call_seconds. It does not tell ordinary proposer/researcher roles the newly enforced aggregate cap or validation timeout. The precheck also counts repeated already-accepted identities before the later skip, so its exact semantics need to be stated.
findings.required: Expose the enforced limit and its counting semantics in the same prospective request/schema the role consumes. No change to proof claims or research priorities is involved.

findings.title: Install/static manifests overstate historical protection and omit a required permissions input
findings.finding: study_manifest sets before={} and constructs each protected before/after SHA by hashing the same current file twice, then announces protected inputs unchanged. This is only a current identity check, not comparison to an approved baseline. Its source enumeration and neutral_checkpoint omit .bootstrap/base-permissions.json, although runtime implementation() pins it and worker permissions reads it. The separate runtime seal provides some later protection; the pre-test/source-install manifest alone is incomplete.
findings.required: Use an approved baseline for historical unchanged assertions or label current pins honestly, and include the required permissions input in the review/reproduction manifest.

repaired_or_qualified: Distinct validation invocations now reserve by resolved destination path, separating branch/round executions while retaining same-operation recovery.
Finished completion receipt binding is checked and reused before reserving fresh budget; terminal reconciliation is also invoked on resolved run recovery.
Policy trial prepays separate incumbent/candidate/evaluation/review pools and debits actual branch operations within their own pool.
Snapshot publication uses a staging directory followed by rename; research-owned observer outbox prevents reading corrupt audit outputs as control input.

Docs explicitly distinguish fixed-round equal upper caps from matched actual-cost efficiency. Protocol transitions have separate 30-second event bounds and observed totals, so they are no longer silently claimed to fit inside arm_seconds.
Docs accurately limit executable changes to a bounded request-transform DSL, conditional formal models, and unproved actual host refinement; no certified switch or fresh Markov activation is claimed.
